cells.name: LIQUIDITY_FRAGILITY_RATIO
cells.measurement_note: ATTRIBUTABLE (DIRECT): a named peer's return, lagged >=1 bar (CrossAssetAdapter) measures a SECOND instrument's move leading this one. UNBLOCKED 2026-08-29: 251 instruments were on disk while the generic family looked at one instrument's own return. The adapter takes a real peer, lags it strictly (lag>=1 is asserted, not assumed), and picks an unnamed peer by shared currency -- NEVER by correlation, which would select on the outcome being tested.
cells.data_source: CFTC Commitments of Traders (dealer net positions) + BIS FX swap line usage data (quarterly) + 1-min FX spot via Dukascopy tick archive
cells.kill: If dealer-ratio flag fails to produce vol expansion exceeding GARCH-implied by >0.5σ in 200 flagged events across 3+ pairs, or effect disappears post-2014 (swap-line regime change), kill

cells.name: RANGE_BREAK_FAILURE_ASYMMETRY
cells.measurement_note: ATTRIBUTABLE (DIRECT): close - open, masked to the session's broker hours measures displacement within a named session window. the session clock comes from the bar index and the displacement IS the quantity the claim is about; nothing is standing in for anything
cells.data_source: Dukascopy 1-min OHLC for EURUSD, AUDUSD, USDJPY (Asia session = 00:00-08:00 Tokyo); identify 50+ pip Asia ranges on prior-NY-non-trend days; measure 30-min price excursion after first touch of range high vs low
cells.kill: If asymmetry <5% after costs or inverts when stratified by prior-day close vs open, or appears only in 1 of 3 pairs, kill

cells.name: breakout-exhaustion-velocity
cells.measurement_note: EXPLORATION ONLY: bar range relative to its median is a heuristic stand-in for spread, depth, or order-book thinness. The cell may run; its result may NOT be read as evidence about liquidity_shock.
cells.data_source: MT5 1-min bars XAUUSD/EURJPY (broker time, all sessions)
cells.kill: kill if mean forward return of exhaustion events is not < random baseline by >=3bps with t-stat <= -2

cells.name: FORCED FLOW TRIGGER
